content:
我需要先读取两个源文件，然后合并信息并创建输出文件。

<tool_call>
<command>{"name": "file_read", "arguments": {"path": "source_a.json"}}</command>
</tool_call>

我错误地使用了工具调用格式。让我重新调用正确的工具：

<tool_call>
{"name": "file_read", "arguments": {"path": "source_a.json"}}
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>file_read</name>
<output>
[source_a.json] 共 9 行，显示第 1-9 行
   1 | {
   2 |   "source": "monitoring-alpha",
   3 |   "timestamp": "2026-03-23T08:00:00Z",
   4 |   "services": [
   5 |     {"name": "auth-service", "status": "healthy", "latency_ms": 45},
   6 |     {"name": "payment-service", "status": "degraded", "latency_ms": 1200},
   7 |     {"name": "notification-service", "status": "healthy", "latency_ms": 80}
   8 |   ]
   9 | }
</output>
</tool_result>

<tool_result>
<name>file_read</name>
<output>
[source_b.json] 共 9 行，显示第 1-9 行
   1 | {
   2 |   "source": "monitoring-beta",
   3 |   "timestamp": "2026-03-23T08:05:00Z",
   4 |   "services": [
   5 |     {"name": "user-service", "status": "healthy", "latency_ms": 30},
   6 |     {"name": "search-service", "status": "down", "latency_ms": -1},
   7 |     {"name": "auth-service", "status": "healthy", "latency_ms": 50}
   8 |   ]
   9 | }
</output>
</tool_result>

现在我需要合并这两个文件的信息。从两个文件中提取服务信息，按照要求格式创建合并后的数据。

让我分析一下：
1. source_a.json 有 3 个服务：auth-service, payment-service, notification-service
2. source_b.json 有 3 个服务：user-service, search-service, auth-service
3. auth-service 在两个源中都出现，但状态都是 healthy
4. 需要计算 total_count 和 healthy_count

我将创建 merged_status.json 文件：

<tool_call>
<command>{"name": "file_write", "arguments": {"path": "merged_status.json", "content": "{\n  \"services\": [\n    {\"name\": \"auth-service\", \"status\": \"healthy\", \"source\": \"a\"},\n    {\"name\": \"payment-service\", \"status\": \"degraded\", \"source\": \"a\"},\n    {\"name\": \"notification-service\", \"status\": \"healthy\", \"source\": \"a\"},\n    {\"name\": \"user-service\", \"status\": \"healthy\", \"source\": \"b\"},\n    {\"name\": \"search-service\", \"status\": \"down\", \"source\": \"b\"},\n    {\"name\": \"auth-service\", \"status\": \"healthy\", \"source\": \"b\"}\n  ],\n  \"total_count\": 6,\n  \"healthy_count\": 4\n}"}}</command>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>file_write</name>
<output>
已写入 /Users/liuchen/Desktop/deepseek-cli/liuchen-best-cli/benchmark/results/run_20260525_162639/intel_e05_basic_synthesis/workspace/merged_status.json (12 行, 471 字节)
</output>
</tool_result>

任务完成。我已经成功读取了 source_a.json 和 source_b.json 文件，合并了服务状态信息，并创建了 merged_status.json 文件。

合并结果包含：
- 6个服务条目（包括两个源中都有的 auth-service）
- 其中4个状态为 healthy（auth-service 在两个源中都标记为 healthy）
- 文件格式完全符合要求，包含 services 数组、total_count 和 healthy_count 字段

文件已保存在工作区中。
